title: Nakagin Board Rectangle Footprint Matches Circle Diameter
description: Nakagin board fixture cs_* rectangles used height 1.38 vs width 0.44 (~3x cluster circle diameter). Regenerate fixture with cs_* squares sized to t_ cluster circle diameter (2*0.22).
summary: Nakagin board `cs_*` rectangles were tall capsules (u/v height 1.38 vs width 0.44, ~3× the cluster circle diameter after scale). The generator now gives `cs_*` squares with side 2× the same u/v radius as `t_*` cluster circles (0.44), and the fixture was regenerated. Kit connections now accept `parent`/`child` as well as legacy `connected`/`connecting` so the script runs against current `metabolism.kit.compose.json`. Ran: bunx vitest run in elements/client/lib/board (46 passed).
